H0001.definition:
אָב (ʼāb) — padre.

【Rango】
1) Padre biológico.
2) Antepasado / patriarca.
3) Título de respeto / origen de un oficio («padre de…»).
4) Dios como Padre (Dt 32:6; Is 63:16; Sal 103:13) — uso más restringido que en el NT, pero real.

【Familia】H0002 אַב (arameo); H0003 אֵב (verdor, distinto).

【LXX】πατήρ (G3962).

【Citas】Gn 2:24; Ex 20:12; Is 63:16; Mal 2:10; Sal 103:13.

H0003.definition:
אֵב (ev) — verdor, brote

【Definición】
freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery

H0004.definition:
אֵב (ev) — fruit

【Definición】
fruit, fresh, young, greening

H0005.definition:
אֲבַגְתָא (a.vag.ta) — Abagtha

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10 § Abagtha = "God-given" one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus

H0006.definition:
אָבַד (a.vad) — perecer, destruir

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
1) perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed
1a) (Qal) 1a1) perish, die, be exterminated 1a2) perish, vanish (fig.) 1a3) be lost, strayed
1b) (Piel) 1b1) to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate 1b2) to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.) 1b3) cause to stray, lose
1c) (Hiphil) 1c1) to destroy, put to death 1c1a) of divine judgment 1c2) object name of kings (fig.)

【Cognados】
H0007, H0008, H0009, H0010, H0011, H0012, H0013

H0007.definition:
אֲבַד (a.vad) — to destroy

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
1) to perish, vanish
1a) (P'al) shall perish
1b) (Aphel) destroy
1c) (Hophal) be destroyed

【Cognados】
H0006, H0008, H0009, H0010, H0011, H0012, H0013

H0008.definition:
אֹבֵד (o.ved) — destruction

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
destruction

【Cognados】
H0006, H0007, H0009, H0010, H0011, H0012, H0013

H0009.definition:
אֲבֵדָה (a.ve.dah) — something lost

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
a lost thing, something lost

【Cognados】
H0006, H0007, H0008, H0010, H0011, H0012, H0013

H0010.definition:
אֲבַדּוֹן (a.vad.don) — destruction

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
a perishing

【Cognados】
H0006, H0007, H0008, H0009, H0011, H0012, H0013

H0011.definition:
אֲבַדּוֹן (a.vad.don) — Abaddon

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
Abaddon, a place of destruction, destruction, ruin

【Cognados】
H0006, H0007, H0008, H0009, H0010, H0012, H0013

H0012.definition:
אַבְדָ֑ן (av.dan) — destruction

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
destruction

【Cognados】
H0006, H0007, H0008, H0009, H0010, H0011, H0013

H0013.definition:
אׇבְדַן (ov.dan) — destruction

【Raíz / familia】
ABD

【Definición】
destruction

【Cognados】
H0006, H0007, H0008, H0009, H0010, H0011, H0012

H0014.definition:
אָבָה (a.vah) — querer, desear

【Definición】
1) to be willing, consent
1a) (Qal) 1a1) to be willing 1a2) to consent, yield to, accept 1a3) to desire

H0015.definition:
אָבִי (a.veh) — deseo, voluntad

【Definición】
entreat, longing, desire

H0017.definition:
אֲבוֹי (a.voy) — pain!

【Definición】
Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain - indicates desire or uneasiness)

H0018.definition:
אֵבוּס (e.vus) — crib

【Definición】
crib, manger, feeding trough

H0019.definition:
אִבְחָה (iv.chah) — slaughter

【Definición】
slaughter, flesh, meat, slaughtered meat

H0021.definition:
אֲבִי (a.vi) — Abi

【Definición】
A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.18.2; daughter of: Zechariah (H2148C); married to Ahaz (H0271); mother of: Hezekiah (H2396); also called Abijah at 2Ch.29.1; Also named: a.viy.yah (אֲבִיָּה "Abijah" H0029N) § Abi = "my father" mother of Hezekiah (cf H029)

H0023.definition:
אֲבִיאָסָף (a.vi.a.saph) — Abiasaph

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.24; son of: Korah (H7141I); brother of: Assir (H0617) and Elkanah (H0511); father of: Assir (H0617H) and Kore (H6981); also called Abiasaph at Exo.6.24; Asaph at 1Ch.26.1; Another name of ev.ya.saph (אֶבְיָסָף, אֲבִיאָסָף "Ebiasaph" H0043) § Abiasaph = "my father has gathered" son (descendant) of Korah

H0024.definition:
אָבִיב (a.viv) — Abib

【Definición】
Month of exodus and passover (March or April) Also named: ni.san (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212) This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley

H0025.definition:
אֲבִי גִבְעוֹן (a.vi giv.on) — Abi-gibeon

【Definición】
Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon" site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place

H0026.definition:
אֲבִיגַ֫יִל, אֲבִיגַ֫ל (a.vi.ga.yil) — Abigail

【Definición】
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.25.3; married to David (H1732) and Nabal (H5037); mother of: Chileab (H3609) § Abigail = "my father is joy" 1) wife of Nabal, then of David

H0027.definition:
אֲבִידָן (a.vi.dan) — Abidan

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.11; son of: Gideoni (H1441) § Abidan = "my father is judge" a prince (ruler) of Benjamin

H0028.definition:
אֲבִידָע (a.vi.da) — Abida

【Definición】
A man of the Midianites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.4; son of: Midian (H4080); brother of: Ephah (H5891), Epher (H6081), Hanoch (H2585I) and Eldaah (H0420) § Abida or Abidah = "my father knows" fourth son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by his wife Keturah (after Sarah died)

H0029.definition:
אֲבִיָּה (a.viy.yah) — Abijah

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.8.2; son of: Samuel (H8050); brother of: Joel (H3100) § Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father" second son of Samuel

H0030.definition:
אֲבִיהוּא (a.vi.hu) — Abihu

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.23; son of: Aaron (H0175) and Elisheba (H0472); brother of: Nadab (H5070), Eleazar (H0499) and Ithamar (H0385) § Abihu = "he is (my) father" a son of Aaron destroyed for sacrificing strange fire to God

H0031.definition:
אֲבִיהוּד (a.vi.hud) — Abihud

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.3; son of: Bela (H1106A); brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265) § Abihud = "my father is majesty" son of Bela, a Benjamite

H0032.definition:
אֲבִיחַ֫יִל (a.vi.ha.yil) — Abihail

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.3.35; father of: Zuriel (H6700) § Abihail = "my father is might" 1) a Levite in Moses's time
2) a Gadite
3) father of Esther
4) wife of Abishur
5) wife of Rehoboam

H0033.definition:
אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי (a.vi ha.ez.ri) — Abiezrite

【Definición】
Someone descended from Abiezer, a man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.26.30; son of: Gilead (H1568H); brother of: Helek (H2507), Asriel (H0844), Shechem (H7928), Shemida (H8061) and Hepher (H2660A); also called Iezer (KJV: Jeezer) at Num.26.30; Group of a.vi.e.zer (אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר "Abiezer" H0044I) § Abiezrite = "my father is help" one of the family of Abiezer, a descendant of Joseph's son, Manasseh

H0034.definition:
אֶבְיוֹן (ev.yon) — needy

【Definición】
1) in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person
2) subject to oppression and abuse
3) needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God
4) general reference to lowest class

H0036.definition:
אֲבִיטוּב (a.vi.tuv) — Abitub

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.11; son of: Shaharaim (H7842) and Hushim (H2366A); brother of: Jobab (H3103J), Zibia (H6644), Mesha (H4331), Malcam (H4445A), Jeuz (H3263), Sachia (H7634), Mirmah (H4821) and Elpaal (H0508) § Abitub = "my father is good(ness)" son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

H0037.definition:
אֲבִיטָ֑ל (a.vi.tal) — Abital

【Definición】
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.4; married to David (H1732); mother of: Shephatiah (H8203) § Abital = "my father is (the) dew" a wife of David

H0038.definition:
אֲבִיָּם (a.viy.yam) — Abijam

【Definición】
A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.14.31; son of: Rehoboam (H7346) and Maacah (H4601K); brother of: Attai (H6262I), Ziza (H2124H) and Shelomith (H8019); father of: Asa (H0609); half-brother of: Jeush (H3266K), Shemariah (H8114H) and Zaham (H2093); also called Abijam (KJV: Abia) at 1Ki.14.31; 15.1,7,8; Another name of a.viy.yah (אֲבִיָּ֫הוּ, אֲבִיָּה "Abijah" H0029I) § Abijam = "my father is the sea" or "Yah(u) is (my) father" king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam

H0039.definition:
אֲבִימָאֵל (a.vi.ma.el) — Abimael

【Definición】
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.28; son of: Joktan (H3355); brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103) § Abimael = "my father is El (God)" son of Joktan, descendant of Shem

H0040.definition:
אֲבִימֶ֫לֶךְ (a.vi.me.lekh) — Abimelech

【Definición】
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.20.2 § Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king" 1) king of Gerar in Abraham's time
2) king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings
3) son of Gideon by a concubine
4) priest, son of Abiathar

H0041.definition:
אֲבִינָדָב (a.vi.na.dav) — Abinadab

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.7.1; father of: Eleazar (H0499H), Uzzah (H5798A), Ahio (H0283) § Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing" 1) a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark
2) second son of Jesse, David's older brother
3) a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines

H0042.definition:
אֲבִינֹ֫עַם (a.vi.no.am) — Abinoam

【Definición】
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.6; father of: Barak (H1301) § Abinoam = "my father is delight" father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali

H0043.definition:
אֶבְיָסָף, אֲבִיאָסָף (ev.ya.saph) — Ebiasaph

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.24; son of: Korah (H7141I); brother of: Assir (H0617) and Elkanah (H0511); father of: Assir (H0617H) and Kore (H6981); also called Abiasaph at Exo.6.24; Asaph at 1Ch.26.1; § Ebiasaph = "my father has gathered" a son or descendant of Korah

H0044.definition:
אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר (a.vi.e.zer) — Abiezer

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.27 § Abiezer = "my father is help" 1) a Manassite, called "son" of Gilead, also son of Gilead's sister
2) a Benjamite, warrior of David

H0045.definition:
אֲבִי־עַלְבוֹן (a.vi-al.von) — Abi-albon

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31 Also named: a.vi.el (אֲבִיאֵל "Abiel" H0022H) § Abialbon = "El (God) is my father" one of David's mighty men (hero)

H0046.definition:
אָבִיר (a.vir) — mighty

【Definición】
1) strong, mighty-used only to describe God
2) the Strong-old name for God (poetic)

H0047.definition:
אַבִּיר (ab.bir) — mighty: ox

【Definición】
1) mighty, valiant
1a) of men
1b) of angels
1c) of animals
1d) (metaph) 1d1) of enemies 1d2) of princes 1d3) of sacrificial objects
1e) obstinate (fig.)

H0048.definition:
אֲבִירָם (a.vi.ram) — Abiram

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Reuben living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.16.1; son of: Eliab (H0446H); brother of: Dathan (H1885) and Nemuel (H5241) § Abiram = "my father is exalted" or "(the) Exalted One is (my) father" 1) a Reubenite, son of Eliab in exodus
2) son of Hiel the Bethelite who worked to rebuild Jericho

H0049.definition:
אֲבִישַׁג (a.vi.shag) — Abishag

【Definición】
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.1.3 § Abishag = "my father is a wanderer" David's beautiful young nurse

H0050.definition:
אֲבִישׁוּעַ (a.vi.shu.a) — Abishua

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.4; son of: Phinehas (H6372); father of: Bukki (H1231H) § Abishua = "my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence" son of Phinehas, grandson of Aaron

H0051.definition:
אֲבִישׁוּר (a.vi.shur) — Abishur

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.28; son of: Shammai (H8060); brother of: Nadab (H5070I); married to Abihail (H0032H); father of: Ahban (H0257) and Molid (H4140) § Abishur = "my father is a wall" son of Shammai, descendant of Judah

【Equivalentes griegos (LXX)】
G0080

H0052.definition:
אֲבִישַׁי (a.vi.shay) — Abishai

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.26.6 and Zeruiah (H6870); brother of: Joab (H3097) and Asahel (H6214) § Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift" grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab

H0053.definition:
אֲבִישָׁלוֹם (a.vi.sha.lom) — Absalom

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.3; son of: David (H1732) and Maacah (H4601I); half-brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); father of: Tamar (H8559I); also called Abishalom at 1Ki.15.2,10; § Absalom or Abishalom = "my father is peace" 1) father-in-law of Rehoboam
2) third son of David, killer of first-born son Amnon, also leader of revolt against his father-David

H0054.definition:
אֶבְיָתָר (ev.ya.tar) — Abiathar

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.22.20; son of: Ahimelech (H0288); father of: Ahimelech (H0288I), Jonathan (H3083I) Also named: Abiathar (Ἀβιαθάρ "Abiathar" G0008) § Abiathar = "my father is great" priest, son of Ahitub (Ahimelech), faithful to David, but later rebelled with Adonijah

H0055.definition:
אָבַךְ (a.vakh) — to roll up

【Definición】
1) to roll, turn
1a) (Hithpael) to roll, roll up, billow

H0056.definition:
אָבַל (a.val) — lamentar, hacer duelo

【Definición】
1) to mourn, lament
1a) (Qal) to mourn, lament 1a1) of humans 1a2) of inanimate objects (fig.) 1a2a) of gates 1a2b) of land
1b) (Hiphil) 1b1) to mourn, cause to mourn (fig.)
1c) (Hithpael) 1c1) to mourn 1c2) play the mourner

H0057.definition:
אָבֵל (a.vel) — mourning

【Definición】
1) mourning
1a) for the dead
1b) because of calamity
1c) of rites of mourning
2) mourner (subst.)
2a) for the dead
2b) for calamity

H0058.definition:
אָבֵל (a.vel) — meadow

【Definición】
meadow (from verb-to grow green, to withstand)

H0059.definition:
אָבֵל (a.vel) — Abel

【Definición】
The place where the ark rested in the field of Joshua at Bethshemesh This name means "stone"

H0060.definition:
אֵ֫בֶל (e.vel) — mourning

【Definición】
1) mourning
1a) for the dead
1b) for rites of mourning (metaph)
1c) mourning garb
1d) period of mourning

H0061.definition:
אֲבָל (a.val) — truly

【Definición】
1) truly, verily, surely
2) but, however, howbeit
3) contrariwise, nay rather (neg.)

H0062.definition:
אָבֵל בֵּית־מֲעַכָה (a.vel bet-ma.a.khah) — Abel-beth-maachah

【Definición】
Abel Beth Maachah = "meadow of the house of Maachah" city in northern Israel near Beth Maachah

H0063.definition:
אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים (a.vel hash.shit.tim) — Abel-shittim

【Definición】
Abel Shittim = "meadow of acacias" place in lowlands of Moab Another name of shit.tim (שִׁטִּים "Shittim" H7851G)

H0064.definition:
אָבֵל כְּרָמִים (a.vel ke.ra.mim) — Abel-keramim

【Definición】
Abel Keramim = "meadow of the vineyards" a place in Ammon

H0065.definition:
אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה (a.vel me.cho.lah) — Abel-meholah

【Definición】
Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing" a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha

H0066.definition:
אַבֵל מַיִם (a.vel ma.yim) — Abel-maim

【Definición】
Abel Maim = "meadow of waters" a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah) Another name of a.vel bet-ma.a.khah (אָבֵל בֵּית־מֲעַכָה "Abel-beth-maachah" H0062)

H0067.definition:
אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם (a.vel mits.ra.yim) — Abel-mizraim

【Definición】
Abel Mizraim = "meadow of Egypt" a place east of the Jordan (perhaps "as fertile as Egypt") Another name of a.tad (אָטָד "Atad" H0329G)

H0068.definition:
אֶ֫בֶן (e.ven) — piedra

【Definición】
stone
1) stone (large or small)
1a) common stone (in natural state)
1b) stone, as material 1b1) of tablets 1b2) marble, hewn stones
1c) precious stones, stones of fire
1d) stones containing metal (ore), tool for work or weapon
1e) weight
1f) plummet (stones of destruction) also made of metal
1g) stonelike objects, eg hailstones, stony heart, ice
1h) sacred object, as memorial Samuel set up to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines
1i) (simile) 1i1) sinking in water, motionlessness 1i2) strength, firmness, solidity 1i3) commonness
1j) (metaph) 1j1) petrified with terror 1j2) perverse, hard heart

H0069.definition:
אֶ֫בֶן (e.ven) — stone

【Definición】
1) stone
1a) a (the) stone
1b) stone, material of idols and buildings

H0070.definition:
אֹבֶן (o.ven) — abanico, red

【Definición】
1) wheel, disc
1a) potter's wheel
1b) bearing-stool, midwife's stool

H0071.definition:
אֲבָנָה (a.va.nah) — Abana

【Definición】
A river in Syria flowing through Damascus Also named: a.ma.nah (אֲמָנָה "Amana" H0549H)

H0072.definition:
אֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר (e.ven ha.e.zer) — Ebenezer

【Definición】
§ Ebenezer = "stone of help" memorial stone erected by Samuel to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines-north of Jerusalem

H0073.definition:
אַבְנֵט (av.net) — girdle

【Definición】
1) girdle, sash, waistband
1a) of high priest
1b) of other priests
1c) of high official

H0074.definition:
אֲבִינֵר (av.ner) — Abner

【Definición】

אַחְאָב (ach.av) — Ahab

【Definición】
A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.28; son of: Omri (H6018); married to Jezebel (H0348); father of: Joash (H3101H), Ahaziah (H0274), Joram (H3141H), Athaliah (H6271) § Ahab = "father's brother" 1) king of Israel, son of Omri, husband of Jezebel
2) false prophet executed by Nebuchadrezzar, time of Jeremiah

H0257.definition:
אַחְבָן (ach.van) — Ahban

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.29; son of: Abishur (H0051) and Abihail (H0032H); brother of: Molid (H4140) § Ahban = "brother of an understanding (intelligent) one" son of Abishur of Judah

H0258.definition:
אָחַד (a.chad) — uno solo

【Definición】
(Hithpael) to go one way or another, to be sharp

H0259.definition:
אֶחָד (e.chad) — uno

【Definición】
1) one (number)
1a) one (number)
1b) each, every
1c) a certain
1d) an (indefinite article)
1e) only, once, once for all
1f) one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one
1g) first
1h) eleven (in combination), eleventh (ordinal)

【Equivalentes griegos (LXX)】
G1520

H0260.definition:
אָחוּ (a.chu) — meadow

【Definición】
reeds, marsh plants, rushes

H0261.definition:
אֵחוּד (e.chud) — Ehud

【Definición】
A Judge of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.15; son of: Gera (H1617); father of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J), Uzza (H5798H) and Ahihud (H0284) Another spelling of e.hud (אֵהוּד "Ehud" H0164) § Ehud = "united" great grandson of Benjamin

H0265.definition:
אֲחוֹחַ (a.cho.ach) — Ahoah

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9; son of: Bela (H1106A); brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4; Also named: a.cho.chi (אֲחוֹחִי "Ahohite" H0266) § Ahoah = "brother of rest" a grandson of Benjamin

H0266.definition:
אֲחוֹחִי (a.cho.chi) — Ahohite

【Definición】
Someone descended from Ahoah, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9; son of: Bela (H1106A); brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4; Group of a.cho.ach (אֲחוֹחַ "Ahoah" H0265) § Ahohite = "brother of rest" one of the clan of Ahoah

H0267.definition:
אֲחוּמַי (a.chu.may) — Ahumai

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.2; son of: Jahath (H3189); brother of: Lahad (H3855) § Ahumai = "a water reed: brother of waters" grandson of Shobal, descendant of Judah

H0268.definition:
אָחוֹר (a.chor) — back

【Definición】
1) the back side, the rear
1a) backwards
1b) hereafter (of time)
1c) behind

H0269.definition:
אָחוֹת (a.chot) — hermana

【Definición】
1) sister
1a) sister (same parents)
1b) half-sister (same father)
1c) relative 1c1) (metaph) of Israel's and Judah's relationship
1d) beloved 1d1) bride
1e) (fig.) of intimate connection
1f) another

H0270.definition:
אָחַז (a.chaz) — asir, tomar posesión

【Definición】
1) grasp, take hold, seize, take possession
1a) (Qal) to grasp, take hold of
1b) (Niphal) to be caught, grasped, be settled
1c) (Piel) to enclose, overlay
1d) (Hophal) fastened

H0271.definition:
אָחָז (a.chaz) — Ahaz

【Definición】
A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.38; son of: Jotham (H3147H); married to Abi (H0021); father of: Hezekiah (H2396) and Maaseiah (H4641J) Also named: Achaz (Ἀχάζ "Ahaz" G0881) § Ahaz = "he has grasped" 1) king of Judah, son Jotham, father of Hezekiah
2) a Benjamite, son of Micah, and great grandson of Jonathan

H0272.definition:
אֲחֻזָּה (a.chuz.zah) — posesión, propiedad

【Definición】
1) possession, property
1a) land
1b) possession by inheritance

H0273.definition:
אַחְזַי (ach.zay) — Ahzai

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12; son of: Meshillemith (H4921); father of: Jahzerah (H3170); also called Ahzai (KJV: Ahasai) at Neh.11.13; Another name of me.shul.lam (מְשֻׁלָּם "Meshullam" H4918M) § Ahasai = "my holder, protector" a post-exilic priest, in Jerusalem

H0274.definition:
אֲחַזְיָ֫הוּ (a.chaz.yah) — Ahaziah

【Definición】
A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.40; son of: Ahab (H0256) and Jezebel (H0348); brother of: Joash (H3101H), Joram (H3141H) and Athaliah (H6271) § Ahaziah = "Jehovah (Yahu) holds (possesses)" 1) ruler of Israel, son of Ahab
2) ruler of Judah, son of Jehoram (Joram)

H0275.definition:
אֲחֻזָּם (a.chuz.zam) — Ahuzzam

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.6; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Naarah (H5292B); brother of: Hepher (H2660), Temeni (H8488) and Haahashtari (H0326); half-brother of: Zereth (H6889), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976) § Ahuzam = "possessor" a descendant of Judah through Caleb

H0276.definition:
אֲחֻזַּת (a.chuz.zat) — Ahuzzath

【Definición】
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.26.26 § Ahuzzath = "possession" friend of Abimelech

H0277.definition:
אֲחִי (a.chi) — Ahi

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Gad living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.15; son of: Abdiel (H5661) § Ahi = "my brother" 1) a head of the families of Gad
2) an Asherite

H0278.definition:
אֵחִי (e.chi) — Ehi

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Aharah at 1Ch.8.1; Also named: ach.rach (אַחְרַח "Aharah" H0315) § Ehi = "my brother" son of Benjamin

H0279.definition:
אֲחִיאָם (a.chi.am) — Ahiam

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.33; son of: Sharar (H8325) § Ahiam = "mother's brother" one of David's warriors (heroes)

H0281.definition:
אֲחִיָּ֫הוּ (a.chiy.yah) — Ahijah

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.3; son of: Seraiah (H8304); brother of: Elihoreph (H0456) § Ahiah or Ahijah = "brother of Jehovah (Yahu)" 1) grandson of Phinehas
2) scribe of Solomon
3) a prophet who predicted the revolt of the Northern tribes
4) father of Baasha, who usurped the Northern throne
5) grandson of Hezron (or mother of 1-4 above)
6) a Benjamite, son of Ehud
7) one of David's heroes
8) a Levite during David's time
9) a chief man under Nehemiah

H0282.definition:
אֲחִיהוּד (a.chi.hud) — Ahihud

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.27; son of: Shelomi (H8015) § Ahihud = "brother of majesty" a prince of Asher

H0283.definition:
אַחְיוֹ (ach.yo) — Ajó

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.6.3; son of: Abinadab (H0041); brother of: Eleazar (H0499H) and Uzzah (H5798A) § Ahio = "brotherly" or "fraternal" 1) son of Abinadab who sheltered the ark
2) a Benjamite
3) another Benjamite of Saul's ancestry

H0284.definition:
אֲחִיחֻד (a.chi.chud) — Ahihud

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.7; son of: Ehud (H0164); brother of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J) and Uzza (H5798H) § Ahihud = "brother of mystery" a Benjamite, son of Ehud

H0285.definition:
אֲחִיטוּב (a.chi.tuv) — Ahitub

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3; son of: Phinehas (H6372H); brother of: Ichabod (H0350); father of: Ahimelech (H0288) § Ahitub = "my brother is good (goodness)" 1) a grandson of Eli
2) the father of Zadok the priest

H0286.definition:
אֲחִילוּד (a.chi.lud) — Ahilud

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.16; father of: Jehoshaphat (H3092), Baana (H1195) § Ahilud = "child's brother" 1) father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder
2) father of Baana, an officer of Solomon

H0287.definition:
אֲחִימוֹת (a.chi.mot) — Ahimoth

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.25; son of: Amasai (H6022); father of: Elkanah (H0511J); also called Mahath at 1Ch.6.35; Also named: ma.chat (מַ֫חַת "Mahath" H4287I) § Ahimoth = "brother of death" or "my brother is death" a son of Elkanah, a Levite

H0288.definition:
אֲחִימֶ֫לֶךְ (a.chi.me.lekh) — Ahimelech

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3; son of: Ahitub (H0285); father of: Abiathar (H0054); also called Ahijah (KJV: Ahiah) at 1Sa.14.3,18; Also named: a.chiy.yah (אֲחִיָּ֫הוּ "Ahijah" H0281O) § Ahimelech = "my brother is king" or "brother of Melek" 1) a priest murdered by Doeg at Saul's command, for supposedly assisting David
2) a Hittite warrior under David

H0289.definition:
אֲחִימַן (a.chi.man) — Ahiman

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.13.22; son of: Anak (H6061); brother of: Sheshai (H8344) and Talmai (H8526) § Ahiman = "my brother is a gift" 1) a son of Anak
2) a Levite servant in the temple

H0290.definition:
אֲחִימַ֫עַץ (a.chi.ma.ats) — Ahimaaz

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50; father of: Ahinoam (H0293) § Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)" 1) father-in-law of Saul
2) Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion
3) a supply officer of Solomon

H0291.definition:
אַחְיָן (ach.yan) — Ahian

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.19; son of: Shemida (H8061); brother of: Shechem (H7928H), Likhi (H3949) and Aniam (H0593) § Ahian = "brotherly" or "fraternal" son of Shemida of Manasseh

H0292.definition:
אֲחִינָדָב (a.chi.na.dav) — Ahinadab

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.14; son of: Iddo (H5714) § Ahinadab = "my brother is liberal, or, noble" a supply officer of Solomon

H0293.definition:
אֲחִינֹ֫עַם (a.chi.no.am) — Ahinoam

【Definición】
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50; daughter of: Ahimaaz (H0290); married to Saul (H7586G); mother of: Jonathan (H3083H), Abinadab (H0041H), Malchi-shua (H4444), Merab (H4764) and Michal (H4324) § Ahinoam = "my brother is delight" 1) wife of Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz
2) wife of David, mother of Amnon, a Jezreelitess

H0294.definition:
אֲחִיסָמָךְ (a.chi.sa.makh) — Ahisamach

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.6; father of: Oholiab (H0171) § Ahisamach = "my brother is support (has supported)" a Danite, father of Aholiab, a workman on the tabernacle

H0295.definition:
אֲחִיעֶ֫זֶר (a.chi.e.zer) — Ahiezer

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.12; son of: Ammishaddai (H5996) § Ahiezer = "my brother is help" 1) a Danite chief who assisted Moses
2) a Danite chief, one of David's heroes

H0296.definition:
אֲחִיקָם (a.chi.qam) — Ahikam

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.22.12; son of: Shaphan (H8227B); brother of: Elasah (H0501J) and Gemariah (H1587H); father of: Gedaliah (H1436B) § Ahikam = "my brother has risen (arisen)" 1) son of Shaphan, an officer in Josiah's reign
2) protector of Jeremiah
3) father of Gedaliah

H0297.definition:
אֲחִירָם (a.chi.ram) — Ahiram

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043) Also named: a.chi.ra.mi (אֲחִירָמִי "Ahiramite" H0298) § Ahiram = "my brother is exalted" or "brother or (the) lofty" a Benjamite, son of Benjamin

H0298.definition:
אֲחִירָמִי (a.chi.ra.mi) — Ahiramite

【Definición】
Someone descended from Ahiram, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043) Group of a.chi.ram (אֲחִירָם "Ahiram" H0297) § Ahiramite = "brother of mother" one of the clan of Ahiram

H0299.definition:
אֲחִירַע (a.chi.ra) — Ahira

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.15; son of: Enan (H5881) § Ahira = "my brother is evil" a chief of Naphtali

H0300.definition:
אֲחִישָׁ֑חַר (a.chi.sha.char) — Ahishahar

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.10; son of: Bilhan (H1092H); brother of: Jeush (H3266H), Benjamin (H1144H), Ehud (H0164H), Chenaanah (H3668H), Zethan (H2133) and Tarshish (H8659I) § Ahishahar = "my brother is dawn" or "brother of the dawn" a Benjamite

H0301.definition:
אֲחִישָׁר (a.chi.shar) — Ahishar

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.6 § Ahishar = "my brother sang" chief steward for Solomon

H0302.definition:
אֲחִיתֹ֫פֶל (a.chi.to.phel) — Ahithophel

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.15.12; father of: Eliam (H0463H) § Ahithophel = "my brother is foolish (folly)" a counsellor of David, grandfather of Bathsheba (cf 2Sa 11:3, 23:34), who joined Absalom in revolt against David, and committed suicide when Absalom did not heed his counsel

H0303.definition:
אַחְלָב (ach.lav) — Ahlab

【Definición】
Ahlab = "fertile place" a town allotted to Asher, site presently unknown Also named: che.vel (חֶ֫בֶל "Mahalab" H2256A)

H0304.definition:
אַחְלָ֑י (ach.lay) — Ahlai

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.31; son of: Sheshan (H8348); married to Jarha (H3398); father of: Attai (H6262) § Ahlai = "O! would that!" 1) daughter of Sheshan
2) father of one of David's heroes (mighty men, warriors)

H0305.definition:
אַחֲלַי (a.cha.lay) — O that!

【Definición】
Oh that...!; oh would that!; ah that!

H0306.definition:
אַחְלָ֑מָה (ach.la.mah) — amethyst

【Definición】
amethyst, a gem in the third row on the ephod, breastplate of judgment worn by the high priest. Transliteration of the Septuagint word. Identification is not certain but is a purple stone perhaps a corundum or red or brown jasper.

H0307.definition:
אַחְמְתָא (ach.me.ta) — Ecbatana

【Definición】
§ Achmetha = "Ecbatana" capital of Media, captured by Cyrus in 550 BC and then summer residence of Persian kings

H0308.definition:
אֲחַסְבַּי (a.chas.bay) — Ahasbai

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.34; father of: Eliphelet (H0467H) § Ahasbai = "brother of my encompassers" father of Eliphelet, one of David's heroes

H0309.definition:
אָחַר (a.char) — tardar, retrasar

【Definición】
1) to delay, hesitate, tarry, defer, remain behind
1a) (Qal) 1a1) to delay, tarry (intensive) 1a2) to cause one to delay, hinder, keep back
1b) (Piel) to delay, wait, stay behind (but not in hope)

H0310.definition:
אַחַר (a.char) — after

【Definición】
1) after the following part, behind (of place), hinder, afterwards (of time)
1a) as an adverb 1a1) behind (of place) 1a2) afterwards (of time)
1b) as a preposition 1b1) behind, after (of place) 1b2) after (of time) 1b3) besides
1c) as a conjunction
1c) after that
1d) as a substantive 1d1) hinder part
1e) with other prepositions 1e1) from behind 1e2) from following after

H0312.definition:
אַחֵר (a.cher) — otro, diferente

【Definición】
1) another, other, following
1a) following, further
1b) other, different

H0313.definition:
אַחֵר (a.cher) — Aher

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.12; father of: Hushim (H2366) § Aher = "following" a Benjamite

H0314.definition:
אַחֲרוֹן (a.cha.ron) — último

【Definición】
1) behind, following, subsequent, western
1a) behind, hindermost, western (of location)
1b) later, subsequent, latter, last (of time)

H0315.definition:
אַחְרַח (ach.rach) — Aharah

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Aharah at 1Ch.8.1; Another name of e.chi (אֵחִי "Ehi" H0278) § Aharah = "a following brother" a son of Benjamin

H0316.definition:
אֲחַרְחֵל (a.char.chel) — Aharhel

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.8; son of: Harum (H2037) § Aharhel = "a following host" a descendant of Judah through Caleb

H0318.definition:
אׇחֳרֵין (o.cho.ren) — finally

【Definición】
1) end, outcome
1a) hid part (of cows)
1b) end (of time)
1c) remnant, descendants

H0319.definition:
אַחֲרִית (a.cha.rit) — fin, posteridad, resultado

【Definición】
1) after part, end
1a) end, issue, event
1b) latter time (prophetic for future time)
1c) posterity
1d) last, hindermost

H0322.definition:
אֲחֹרַנִּית (a.cho.ran.nit) — backwards

【Definición】
backwards, back part, the rear

H0323.definition:
אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפַּן (a.chash.dar.pan) — satrap

【Definición】
satrap, a governor of a Persian province

H0324.definition:
אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנִין (a.chash.dar.pan) — satrap

【Definición】
satrap, a governor of a Persian province

H0325.definition:
אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ (a.chash.ve.rosh) — Ahasuerus

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.4.6; married to Vashti (H2060); father of: Darius (H1868H) § Ahasuerus = "I will be silent and poor" title of the king of Persia, probably Xerxes

H0326.definition:
אֲחַשְׁתָּרִי (a.chash.ta.ri) — Haahashtari

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.6; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Naarah (H5292B); brother of: Ahuzzam (H0275), Hepher (H2660) and Temeni (H8488); half-brother of: Zereth (H6889), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976) § Haahashtari = "I will diligently observe the searching" a descendant of Ashur of Judah

H0329.definition:
אָטָד (a.tad) — Atad

【Definición】
Atad, a threshing floor afterwards called Bethhogla was located on the west of Jordan between the Jordan and Jericho Also named: a.vel mits.ra.yim (אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם "Abel-mizraim" H0067)

אָלַח (a.lach) — to corrupt

【Definición】
(Niphal) to be corrupt morally, tainted

H0445.definition:
אֶלְחָנָן (el.cha.nan) — Elhanan

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.21.19; son of: Jaare-oregim (H3296) § Elhanan = "God has been gracious" 1) Jair's son who fought the Gittites
2) Dodo's son who was a chief of David

H0446.definition:
אֱלִיאָב (e.li.av) — Eliab

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.9; son of: Helon (H2497) § Eliab = "my God is father" or "God is father" 1) son of Helon, leader of Zebulun in the wilderness
2) a Reubenite chief, father of Dathan and Abiram
3) David's oldest brother
4) a Levite musician
5) a Gadite warrior for David
6) a Kohathite

H0447.definition:
אֱלִיאֵל (e.li.el) — Eliel

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.24 § Eliel = "my God is God" or "El is God" 1) an ancestor of Samuel
2) chief in David's army (might be two or three different men)
3) a Levite with David in moving the ark
4) a chief of Manasseh
5) two chiefs of Benjamin
6) a chief Kohathite
7) a Levite

H0448.definition:
אֳלִיאָ֫תָה (e.li.a.tah) — Eliathah

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.25.4; son of: Heman (H1968I); brother of: Bukkiah (H1232), Mattaniah (H4983H), Uzziel (H5816J), Shebuel (H7619H), Jerimoth (H3406L), Hananiah (H2608P), Hanani (H2607H), Giddalti (H1437), Romamti-ezer (H7320), Joshbekashah (H3436), Mallothi (H4413), Hothir (H1956), Mahazioth (H4238) § Eliathah = "God has come" a Hemanite musician in David's court

H0449.definition:
אֱלִידָד (e.li.dad) — Elidad

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.21; son of: Chislon (H3692) § Elidad = "my God has loved" a Benjamite chief who helped apportion his tribe's allotment to the Promised Land

H0450.definition:
אֶלְיָדָע (el.ya.da) — Eliada

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.16; son of: David (H1732); brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); also called Beeliada at 1Ch.14.7; Also named: be.el.ya.da (בְּעֶלְיָדָע "Beeliada" H1182) § Eliadah or Eliada = "God knows" 1) a son of David
2) a Benjamite warrior chief
3) an Aramean, the father of an enemy of Solomon

H0451.definition:
אַלְיָה (al.yah) — fat tail

【Definición】
tail, fat-tail (of sheep-an Eastern delicacy)

H0452.definition:
אֵלִיָּה (e.liy.yah) — Elijah

【Definición】
A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.17.1 Also named: Hēlias (Ἡλίας "Elijah" G2243) § Elijah or Eliah = "my God is Jehovah" or "Yah(u) is God" 1) the great prophet of the reign of Ahab
2) Benjamite son of Jeroham
3) a son of Elam with foreign wife during exile
4) a son of Harim, and priest, with foreign wife during exile

H0453.definition:
אֱלִיהוּ (e.li.hu) — Elihu

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.1.1; son of: Tohu (H8459); father of: Jeroham (H3395); also called Eliab at 1Ch.6.27; Eliel at 1Ch.6.34; § Elihu = "He is my God" 1) the younger man who rebuked Job and his three friends
2) an Ephraimite, Samuel's great grandfather
3) a Manassite warrior chief for David
4) son of Shemaiah and Korhite gatekeeper
5) David's brother

H0454.definition:
אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי (el.ye.ho.e.nay) — Eliehoenai

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.26.3; son of: Meshelemiah (H4920); brother of: Zechariah (H2148A), Jediael (H3043J), Zebadiah (H2069J), Jathniel (H3496), Elam (H5867H) and Jehohanan (H3076I) § Elioenai or Elihoenai = "unto Jehovah are my eyes" 1) a Korahite temple doorkeeper, son of Meshelemiah
2) a returning exile

H0455.definition:
אֶלְיַחְבָּא (el.yach.ba) — Eliahba

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.32 § Eliahba = "God hides" one of David's mighty warriors

H0456.definition:
אֱלִיחֹ֫רֶף (e.li.cho.reph) — Elihoreph

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.3; son of: Seraiah (H8304); brother of: Ahijah (H0281) § Elihoreph = "God of winter (harvest-time)" a scribe in Solomon's court

H0457.definition:
אֱלִיל (e.lil) — ídolo, vanidad

【Definición】
1) of nought, good for nothing, worthless
1a) of physicians, a shepherd, a divination
1b) of false gods

H0458.definition:
אֱלִימֶ֫לֶךְ (e.li.me.lekh) — Elimelech

【Definición】
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.1.2; married to Naomi (H5281); father of: Mahlon (H4248), Chilion (H3630) § Elimelech = "my God is king" Naomi's husband

H0460.definition:
אֶלְיָסָף (el.ya.saph) — Eliasaph

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.14; son of: Jethro (H3503); brother of: Zipporah (H6855) and Hobab (H2246) § Eliasaph = "God has added" 1) a Gadite chief in the wilderness census
2) a head of the Gershonites

H0461.definition:
אֱלִיעֶ֫זֶר (e.li.e.zer) — Eliezer

【Definición】
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.15.2 § Eliezer = "God is help" 1) Abraham's Damascene servant
2) a son of Moses
3) a Benjamite
4) a priest who helped move the ark
5) a Reubenite
6) a prophet who spoke to Jehoshaphat
7) a Levite chief
8) son of Harim
9) priest with foreign wife

H0462.definition:
אֱלִיעֵינַי (e.li.e.nay) — Elienai

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.20; son of: Shimei (H8096N); brother of: Jakim (H3356), Zichri (H2147H), Zabdi (H2067H), Zillethai (H6769), Eliel (H0447H), Adaiah (H5718H), Beraiah (H1256) and Shimrath (H8119) § Elienai = "unto God are my eyes" a Benjamite

H0463.definition:
אֱלִיעָם (e.li.am) — Eliam

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.11.3; father of: Bathsheba (H1339); also called Ammiel at 1Ch.3.5; Also named: am.mi.el (עַמִּיאֵל "Ammiel" H5988J) § Eliam = "God of the people" or "God is kinsman" 1) Bathsheba's father
2) a Gilonite warrior of David

H0464.definition:
אֱלִיפַז (e.li.phaz) — Eliphaz

【Definición】
A man of the Edomites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.4; son of: Esau (H6215) and Adah (H5711H); half-brother of: Reuel (H7467), Jeush (H3266), Jalam (H3281) and Korah (H7141); married to Timna (H8555); father of: Teman (H8487), Omar (H0201), Zepho (H6825), Gatam (H1609), Kenaz (H7073), Amalek (H6002H) and Korah (H7141H) § Eliphaz = "my God is (fine) gold" 1) Esau's son, father of Teman
2) the Temanite friend of Job

H0465.definition:
אֱלִיפָל (e.li.phal) — Eliphal

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.35; son of: Ur (H0218A) § Eliphal = "my God is supplication" one of David's mighty warriors

H0466.definition:
אֱלִיפְלֵ֫הוּ (e.liph.le.hu) — Eliphelehu

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18 § Elipheleh = "my God sets him apart" or "my God distinguishes him" a Levite gatekeeper and musician for David

H0467.definition:
אֲלִיפֶ֫לֶט (e.li.phe.let) — Eliphelet

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.16; son of: David (H1732); brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N) § Elpalet or Eliphalet or Eliphelet = "God is deliverance" 1) David's youngest son
2) one of David's mighty warriors
3) a Benjamite descendant of Jonathan
4) a leader of the clan of Adonikam
5) one of the line of Hashum

H0468.definition:
אֱלִיצוּר (e.li.tsur) — Elizur

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.5; son of: Shedeur (H7707) § Elizur = "my God is a rock" or "Rock is God" a chief of Reuben in the wilderness

H0469.definition:
אֱלִיצָפָן (e.li.tsa.phan) — Elizaphan

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.22; son of: Uzziel (H5816); brother of: Mishael (H4332), Sithri (H5644), Micah (H4318J) and Isshiah (H3449I); also called Elzaphan at Exo.6.22; 1x § Elizaphan or Elzaphan = "my God has protected" 1) a Kohathite chief in the wilderness
2) a Zebulunite chief
3) Uzziel's son, Mishael's brother in time of Moses

H0470.definition:
אֱלִיקָא (e.li.qa) — Elika

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.25 § Elika = "my God rejects" one of David's mighty warriors

H0471.definition:
אֶלְיָקִים (el.ya.qim) — Eliakim

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.18.18; son of: Hilkiah (H2518) § Eliakim = "God raises" or "God sets up" 1) the son of Hilkiah, master of Hezekiah's household
2) Josiah's son, enthroned by Pharaoh
3) a priest who assisted Nehemiah

H0472.definition:
אֱלִישֶׁ֫בַע (e.li.she.va) — Elisheba

【Definición】
A woman of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Exo.6.23; daughter of: Amminadab (H5992); sister of: Nahshon (H5177); married to Aaron (H0175); mother of: Nadab (H5070), Abihu (H0030), Eleazar (H0499) and Ithamar (H0385) § Elisheba = "my God has sworn" or "God is an oath" Aaron's wife

H0473.definition:
אֱלִישָׁה (e.li.shah) — Elishah

【Definición】
A man of the Greeks living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.4; son of: Javan (H3120); brother of: Tarshish (H8659), Kittim (H3794) and Dodanim (H1721) § Elishah = "God of the coming (one)" descendant of Noah, son of Javan; perhaps ancestor of the Aeolians

H0474.definition:
אֱלִישׁוּעַ (e.li.shu.a) — Elishua

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.15; son of: David (H1732); brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); also called Elishama at 1Ch.3.6; Also named: e.li.sha.ma (אֱלִישָׁמָע "Elishama" H0476M) § Elishua = "my God is wealth" or "God is salvation" a son of David

H0475.definition:
אֶלְיָשִׁיב (el.ya.shiv) — Eliashib

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.24; son of: Elioenai (H0454B); brother of: Hodaviah (H1938), Pelaiah (H6411B), Akkub (H6126), Johanan (H3110I), Delaiah (H1806) and Anani (H6054) § Eliashib = "God restores" 1) a priest in David's reign
2) a descendant of David
3) a high priest in Nehemiah's time
4) a temple singer with foreign wife
5) one of the line of Zattu
6) one of the line of Bani

H0476.definition:
אֱלִישָׁמָע (e.li.sha.ma) — Elishama

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.10; son of: Ammihud (H5989); father of: Nun (H5126) § Elishama = "my God has heard" 1) an Ephraimite chief in the wilderness
2) a son of David
3) Jehoiakim's secretary
4) a priest who taught the law
5) a man of Judah

H0477.definition:
אֱלִישָׁע (e.li.sah) — Elisha

【Definición】
A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.19.16; son of: Shaphat (H8202H) Also named: Elissaios (Ἐλισσαῖος "Elisha" G1666) § Elisha = "God is salvation" the great prophet who succeeded Elijah

H0478.definition:
אֱלִישָׁפָט (e.li.sha.phat) — Elishaphat

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.23.1; son of: Zichri (H2147O) § Elishaphat = "my God has judged" a captain for the high priest Jehoiada

H0481.definition:
אָלַם (a.lam) — be dumb

【Definición】
1) to bind
1a) (Niphal) 1a1) to be dumb 1a2) to be bound
1b) (Piel) binding (part.)

H0483.definition:
אִלֵּם (il.lem) — mute

【Definición】
mute, silent, dumb, unable to speak

H0484.definition:
אַלְמֻגִּים (al.mug.gim) — almug

【Definición】
a tree from Lebanon, almug trees (sandalwood?), almug wood

H0485.definition:
אֲלֻמָה (a.lum.mah) — sheaf

【Definición】
1) sheaf (as something bound)
1a) of Israel returning from exile (fig.)

H0486.definition:
אַלְמוֹדָד (al.mo.dad) — Almodad

【Definición】
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.26; son of: Joktan (H3355); brother of: Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Abimael (H0039), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103) § Almodad = "not measured" a descendant of Shem

H0487.definition:
אַלַּמֶּלֶךְ (al.lam.me.lekh) — Allammelech

【Definición】
§ Alammelech = "oak of the king" a town or site in Asher

H0488.definition:
אַלְמָן (al.man) — forsaken

【Definición】
widowed, forsaken, forsaken as a widow

H0492.definition:
אַלְמֹנִי (al.mo.ni) — someone

【Definición】
someone, a certain one

H0493.definition:
אֶלְנָ֑עַם (el.na.am) — Elnaam

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.46; father of: Jeribai (H3403), Joshaviah (H3145) § Elnaam = "God is delight" or "God is pleasantness" the father of two of David's mighty warriors

H0494.definition:
אֶלְנָתָן (el.na.tan) — Elnathan

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.24.8; father of: Nehushta (H5179) § Elnathan = "God has given" 1) king Jehoiachin's maternal grandfather
2) three chief men in Ezra's time
3) son of Achbor, a military commander under Jehoiakim

H0495.definition:
אֶלָּסָר (el.la.sar) — Ellasar

【Definición】
§ Ellasar = "God is chastener" a town in Babylonia, c. 28 miles (50 km) E of Ur

H0496.definition:
אֶלְעָד (el.ad) — Elead

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.21; son of: Ephraim (H0669); brother of: Shuthelah (H7803), Becher (H1071H), Tahan (H8465), Ezer (H5827) and Beriah (H1283H) § Elead = "God has testified" a descendant of Ephraim

H0497.definition:
אֶלְעָדָה (el.a.dah) — Eleadah

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.20; son of: Tahath (H8480I); father of: Tahath (H8480J); also called in KJV: Eladah; § Eladah = "God has adorned" a descendant of Ephraim

H0498.definition:
אֶלְעוּזַי (el.u.zay) — Eluzai

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.5 § Eluzai = "God is my strength" a Benjamite warrior who joined David

H0499.definition:
אֶלְעָזָר (el.a.zar) — Eleazar

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.23; son of: Aaron (H0175) and Elisheba (H0472); brother of: Nadab (H5070), Abihu (H0030) and Ithamar (H0385); married to daughter_of_Putiel (H6317H); father of: Phinehas (H6372) § Eleazar = "God has helped" 1) the high priest son of Aaron
2) Abinadab's son who cared for the ark
3) the priest who rebuilt and dedicated the restored walls of Jerusalem in time of Ezra
4) one of David's mighty warriors
5) a Levite
6) one of the line of Parosh

H0500.definition:
אֶלְעָלֵא (el.a.le) — Elealeh

【Definición】
§ Elealeh = "God is ascending" a Reubenite village near Heshbon (in ruins)

H0501.definition:
אֶלְעָשָׂה (el.a.sah) — Eleasah

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.39; son of: Helez (H2503H); father of: Sismai (H5581) § Elasah or Eleasah = "God has made" 1) a descendant of Judah, son of Helez
2) a priest of Pashur's line with a foreign wife during Ezra's time
3) Shaphan's son, Zedekiah's servant
4) a descendant of Benjamin, son of Rapha, father of Azel

H0502.definition:
אָלַף (a.laph) — to teach/learn

【Definición】
1) to learn
1a) (Qal) to learn
1b) (Piel) to teach

H0503.definition:
אָלַף (a.laph) — to produce thousands

【Definición】
v
1) (CLBL) to make thousand-fold, bring forth thousands
2) (TWOT) (Hiphil) producing thousands n m
3)(BDB) chief, chiliarch

H0504.definition:
אֶ֫לֶף (e.leph) — cattle

【Definición】
1) cattle, oxen
1a) in farming
1b) as a possession

H0505.definition:
אֶ֫לֶף (e.leph) — mil

【Definición】
thousand
1) a thousand
1a) as numeral
2) a thousand, company
2a) as a company of men under one leader, troops

H0507.definition:
הָאֶ֫לֶף (e.leph) — Haeleph

【Definición】
§ Eleph = "thousand" a city in the territory of Benjamin

H0508.definition:
אֶלְפַּ֫עַל (el.pa.al) — Elpaal

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.8.11; son of: Shaharaim (H7842) and Hushim (H2366A); brother of: Jobab (H3103J), Zibia (H6644), Mesha (H4331), Malcam (H4445A), Jeuz (H3263), Sachia (H7634), Mirmah (H4821) and Abitub (H0036); father of: Eber (H5677I), Misham (H4936), Shemed (H8106B), Beriah (H1283I), Shema (H8087I), Zebadiah (H2069H), Meshullam (H4918J), Hizki (H2395), Heber (H2268J), Ishmerai (H3461), Izliah (H3152), Jobab (H3103K) § Elpaal = "God is maker" a Benjamite

H0510.definition:
אַלְקוּם (al.qum) — army

【Definición】
1) (TWOT) (neg adv) no, not, nor, neither
2) (BDB) band of soldiers
3) (CLBL) no rebellion, no uprising (lit.)

H0511.definition:
אֶלְקָנָה (el.qa.nah) — Elkanah

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.24; son of: Korah (H7141I); brother of: Assir (H0617) and Ebiasaph (H0043) § Elkanah = "God has possessed" or "God has created" 1) Samuel's father
2) a ruler in Jerusalem in the time of king Ahaz
3) one of David's mighty warriors
4) son of Korah
5) several Levites

H0512.definition:
אֶלְקֹשִׁי (el.qo.shi) — Elkoshite

【Definición】
§ Elkoshite = "God the ensnarer" a native and/or descendant of Elkosh (location unknown)

H0513.definition:
אֶלְתּוֹלַד (el.to.lad) — Eltolad

【Definición】
§ Eltolad = "God's generations" a city in southern Judah

H0514.definition:
אֶלְתְּקֵא (el.te.qe) — Eltekeh

【Definición】
§ Eltekeh = "let God spue thee out" Levitical city in the tribe of Dan, between Ekron and Timna

H0515.definition:

H1121.definition:
בֵּן (bēn) — hijo; descendiente.

【Raíz / familia】
De בנה (banáh, edificar). El hijo «edifica» el nombre y la casa del padre. Muy productivo en constructos: «hijo de» = miembro de, digno de, destinado a.

【Rango】
1) Hijo biológico.
2) Descendiente.
3) Miembro de un gremio o clase («hijos de los profetas»).
4) Idiomático: hijo de la muerte, hijo de valentía, etc.

【Cognados】
H1323 בַּת (hija); H1129 בָּנָה (edificar); H1146 בִּנְיָן (edificio).

【LXX】υἱός (G5207).

【Citas】Gn 22:2; Ex 4:22; Sal 2:7; Dn 7:13 (arameo bar).
sources: El Lugar · ficha ES (esquema de estudio superador)
H1121.gloss_es: hijo; descendiente; miembro de un grupo
H1121.root_family: Raíz בנה (b-n-h) «edificar». בֵּן = el que «edifica» la casa / linaje.

H1122.definition:
בֵּן (ben) — Ben

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.15.18 § Ben = "son" a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark

H1124.definition:
בְּנָה (be.nah) — to build

【Definición】
1) to build
1a) (P'al) to build
1b) (Ithp'il) to be built

H1125.definition:
בֶּן־אֲבִינָדָב (ben-a.vi.na.dav) — Ben-Abinadab

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.11; son of: Abinadab (H0041J); married to Taphath (H2955) § Ben-Abinadab = "son of Abinadab" an officer of Solomon

H1126.definition:
בֶּן־אוֹנִ֑י (ben-o.ni) — Ben-oni

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); brother of: Joseph (H3130); half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x Another name of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144G) § Ben-oni = "son of my sorrow" the name given to Benjamin by Rachel

H1127.definition:
בֶּן־גֶּ֫בֶר (ben-ge.ver) — Ben-Geber

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.13; son Geber (H1398) § Ben-geber = "the son of Geber" or "the son of a man" an officer of Solomon

H1128.definition:
בֶּן־דֶּ֫קֶר (ben-de.qer) — Ben-deker

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.9; son of: Deker (H1857) § Ben-dekar = "son of stabbing" or "son of Dekar" an officer of Solomon

H1129.definition:
בָּנָה (ba.nah) — edificar, construir, reedificar

【Raíz / familia】
BNH

【Definición】
1) to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue
1a) (Qal) 1a1) to build, rebuild 1a2) to build a house (ie, establish a family)
1b) (Niphal) 1b1) to be built 1b2) to be rebuilt 1b3) established (of restored exiles) (fig.) 1b4) established (made permanent) 1b5) to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine)

【Cognados】
H1140, H1146

【Citas】
Gn 8:20, Ne 2:5, Sal 127:1

H1130.definition:
בֶּן־הֲדַד (ben-ha.dad) — Ben-hadad

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.15.18; son of: Tabrimmon (H2886) § Ben-hadad = "son of [the false god] Hadad" 1) the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah
2) the son of Hazael, also king of Syria

H1131.definition:
בִּנּוּי (bin.nuy) — Binnui

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.10; also called Binnui at Neh.7.15; Another spelling of ba.ni (בָּנִי "Bani" H1137Q) § Binnui = "built up" 1) an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah
2) a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah
3) another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife
4) still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife

H1132.definition:
בֶּן־זוֹחֵת (ben-zo.chet) — Ben-zoheth

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20; son of: Ishi (H3469H); brother of: Zoheth (H2105) § Ben-zoheth = "son of Zoheth" one of the tribe of Judah

H1133.definition:
בֶּן־חוּר (ben-chur) — Ben-hur

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.8; son of: Hur (H1133H) § Ben-hur = "son of whiteness" or "son of Chur" a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim

H1134.definition:
בֶּן־חַ֫יִל (ben-cha.yil) — Ben-hail

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.17.7 § Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might" a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat

H1135.definition:
בֶּן־חָנָן (ben-cha.nan) — Ben-hanan

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20; son of: Shimon (H7889); brother of: Amnon (H0550H), Rinnah (H7441) and Tilon (H8436) § Ben-hanan = "son of favour" one of the tribe of Judah

H1136.definition:
בֶּן־חֶ֫סֶד (ben-che.sed) — Ben-hesed

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.10; son of: Hesed (H2618) § Ben-hesed = "son of mercy" an officer of Solomon

H1137.definition:
בָּנִי (ba.ni) — Bani

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.36 § Bani = "built" 1) a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors
2) a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan
3) a man of Judah of the line of Pharez
4) "children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel
5) one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time

H1138.definition:
בֻּנִּי (bun.ni) — Bunni

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.9.4 § Bunni = "built" 1) a Levite in the time of Nehemiah
2) another Levite of earlier date

H1139.definition:
בְּנֵי־בְרַק (be.ne-b.raq) — Bene-berak

【Definición】
§ Bene-barak = "sons of lightning" a city in Dan

H1140.definition:
בִּנְיָה (bin.yah) — building

【Raíz / familia】
BNH

【Definición】
structure, building

【Cognados】
H1129, H1146

H1141.definition:
בְּנָיָ֫הוּ (be.na.yah) — Benaiah

【Definición】
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18; son of: Jehoiada (H3077); father of: Ammizabad (H5990) § Benaiah = "Jehovah has built" or "Yahweh has built up" 1) one of David's mighty warriors, son of Jehoiada the chief priest, a Levite, set by David over his bodyguard, later having remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah's attempt on the crown, was raised into the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the army
2) the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, and the captain of the eleventh monthly course
3) a Simeonite, a prince of the families of Simeon
4) a Levite in the time of David who played with a psaltery on Alamoth
5) a priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark
6) a Levite of the sons of Asaph
7) a Levite in the time of Hezekiah
8) Four Israelites in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives
9) the father of Pelatiah

H1142.definition:
בְּנֵי יַעֲקָ֑ן (be.ne ya.a.qan) — Bene-jaakan

【Definición】
§ Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting" an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as be.e.rot be.ne-ya.a.qan (בְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָן "Beeroth-bene-jaakan" H0885))

H1143.definition:
בֵּנַיִם (be.na.yim) — champion

【Definición】
1) between, space between two armies
1a) man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)

H1144.definition:
בִּנְיָמִין (bin.ya.min) — Benjamín

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); brother of: Joseph (H3130); half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x § Benjamin = "son of the right hand" 1) Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother
2) son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin
3) a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
4) the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob

H1145.definition:
בֶּן־יְמִינִי (ben-y.mi.ni) — Benjaminite

【Definición】
Someone from the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); brother of: Joseph (H3130); half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x Group of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144) § Benjamite = "a son of the right hand" one of the tribe of Benjamin

H1146.definition:
בִּנְיָן (bin.yan) — edificio, estructura

【Raíz / familia】
BNH

【Definición】
structure, building

【Cognados】
H1129, H1140

H1148.definition:
בְּנִ֑ינוּ (be.ni.nu) — Beninu

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.13 § Beninu = "our son" a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

H1149.definition:
בְּנַס (be.nas) — be angry

【Definición】
(P'al) to be angry

H1150.definition:
בִּנְעָא (bin.a) — Binea

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.8.37; son of: Moza (H4162H); father of: Raphah (H7498), Eleasah (H0501H) and Azel (H0682A) § Binea or Bineah = fountain a descendant of Jonathan

H1151.definition:
בֶּן־עַמִּי (ben-am.mi) — Ben-ammi

【Definición】
A man of Ammon living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.19.38; son of: Lot (H3876) and his second daughter (H3876I); half-brother of Moab (H4124H) § Ben-ami = "son of my people" son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites

H1152.definition:
בְּסוֹדְיָ֑ה (be.so.de.yah) — Besodeiah

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.6; father of: Meshullam (H4918S) § Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord" father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah

H1153.definition:
בֵּסַי (be.say) — Besai

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.49 § Besai = "my treading" a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel

H1154.definition:
בֶּסֶר (be.ser) — unripe grape

【Definición】
unripe or sour grapes Another spelling of bo.ser (בֹּ֫סֶר "unripe grape" H1155)

H1155.definition:
בֹּ֫סֶר (bo.ser) — unripe grape

【Definición】
unripe grapes, sour grapes

H1156.definition:
בְּעָא (be.a) — to ask

【Definición】
1) to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition
1a) (P'al) 1a1) to ask, request 1a2) to seek (for favour)

H1157.definition:
בַּ֫עַד (be.ad) — about/through/for

【Definición】
1) behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about
1a) through (of action)
1b) behind (with verbs of shutting)
1c) about (with verbs of fencing)
1d) on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)

H1158.definition:
בָּעָה (ba.ah) — to enquire

【Definición】
1) to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire
1a) (Qal) 1a1) to seek, enquire 1a2) to cause to boil up
1b) (Niphal) 1b1) to be searched out 1b2) to be swelling, bulging, swelling out

H1159.definition:
בָּעוּ (ba.u) — petition

【Definición】
1) petition, request
2) prayer (always in Jewish liturgy)

H1160.definition:
בְּעוֹר (be.or) — Beor

【Definición】
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.32; father of: Bela (H1106) § Beor = "burning" 1) father of Balaam
2) father of Bela, king of Edom

H1161.definition:
בִּעוּתִים (bi.u.tim) — terror

【Definición】
terrors, alarms (occasioned by God)

H1162.definition:
בֹּ֫עַז (bo.az) — Boaz

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.2.1; son of: Salmon (H8007) and Rahab (H7343); married to Ruth (H7327); father of: Obed (H5744) Also named: Booz (Βοόζ "Boaz" G1003) § Boaz = "fleetness" 1) ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi
2) name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple

H1163.definition:
בָּעַט (ba.at) — to kick

【Definición】
1) to kick, kick at
1a) (Qal) 1a1) to kick 1a2) to kick at 1a3) to desire (fig.)

H1164.definition:
בְּעִי (be.i) — ruins

【Definición】
ruin, heap of ruins Another spelling of i (עִי "ruin" H5856)

H1166.definition:
בָּעַל (ba.al) — rule: to rule

【Definición】
1) to rule over, possess, own
1a) (Qal) 1a1) to be lord over 1a2) to rule over
1b) (Niphal) to be ruled § 1) to marry, rule over, possess, own
1a) (Qal) 1a1) to marry, be lord (husband) over 1a2) to rule over
1b) (Niphal) to be married

H1167.definition:
בַּעַל (ba.al) — dueño, marido, baal

【Definición】
master/leader
1) owner, husband, lord
1a) owner
1b) a husband
1c) citizens, inhabitants
1d) rulers, lords
1e) (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams)

H1168.definition:
בַּעַל (ba.al) — Baal

【Definición】
§ Baal = "lord" esp. lord, specif. as divine name, Baal supreme male divinity of the Phoenicians or Canaanites

H1170.definition:
בַּעַל בְּרִית (ba.al be.rit) — Baal-berith

【Definición】
§ Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant" a god of the Philistines

H1171.definition:
בַּ֫עַל גָּד (ba.al gad) — Baal-gad

【Definición】
Baal-gad = "lord of fortune" a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

H1172.definition:
בַּעֲלָה (ba.a.lah) — mistress

【Definición】
1) mistress, female owner
2) sorceress, necromancer (noun of relationship)

H1174.definition:
בַּ֫עַל הָמוֹן (ba.al ha.mon) — Baal-hamon

【Definición】
Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance" the site of Solomon's vineyard Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

H1175.definition:
בְּעָלוֹת (be.a.lot) — Bealoth

【Definición】
Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses" a town in south Judah Another name of ba.a.lat be.er (בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר "Baalath-beer" H1192)

H1176.definition:
בַּעַל זְבוּב (ba.al ze.vuv) — Baal-zebub

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.1.2 § Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly" a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron

H1177.definition:
בַּ֫עַל חָנָן (ba.al cha.nan) — Baal-hanan

【Definición】
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.38; son of: Achbor (H5907) § Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious" 1) an early king of Edom
2) one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations

H1178.definition:
בַּ֫עַל חָצוֹר (ba.al cha.tsor) — Baal-hazor

【Definición】
§ Baal-hazor = "lord of the village" a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder

H1179.definition:
בַּ֫עַל חֶרְמוֹן (ba.al cher.mon) — (Mount) Baal-hermon

【Definición】
Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction" a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

H1180.definition:
בַּעֲלִי (ba.a.li) — Baal

【Definición】
Baali = "my lord" a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal' Another name of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068G)

H1181.definition:
בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת (ba.a.le ba.mot) — Baal-bamothite

【Definición】
Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places" the people of Arnon, east of Jordan

H1182.definition:
בְּעֶלְיָדָע (be.el.ya.da) — Beeliada

【Definición】
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.16; son of: David (H1732); brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); also called Beeliada at 1Ch.14.7; Another name of el.ya.da (אֶלְיָדָע "Eliada" H0450G) § Beeliada = "the lord knows" a son of David, born in Jerusalem, elsewhere named 'Eliada'

H1183.definition:
בַּעַלְיָה (be.al.yah) — Bealiah

【Definición】
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.5 § Bealiah = "Jehovah is master" a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors

H1184.definition:
בַּעֲלֵי יְהוּדָה (ba.a.le ye.hu.dah) — Baale-judah

【Definición】
Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah" a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab Combined with qir.yat ye.a.rim (קִרְיַת יְעָרִים "Kiriath-jearim" H7157)

H1185.definition:
בַּעֲלִיס (ba.a.lis) — Baalis

【Definición】
A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.14 § Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy" king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar

H1186.definition:
בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן (ba.al me.on) — Baal-meon

【Definición】
§ Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation" a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite

H1187.definition:
בַּ֫עַל פְּעוֹר (ba.al pe.or) — Baal of Peor

【Definición】
Baal-peor = "lord of the gap" the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites Another name of ba.al (בַּעַל "Baal" H1168A)

H1188.definition:
בַּ֫עַל פְּרָצִים (ba.al pe.ra.tsim) — Baal-perazim

【Definición】
§ Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks" the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim'

H1189.definition:
בַּ֫עַל צְפוֹן (ba.al tse.phon) — Baal-zephon

【Definición】
§ Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north" a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus

H1190.definition:
בַּ֫עַל שָׁלִשָׁה (ba.al sha.li.shah) — Baal-shalishah

【Definición】
§ Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord" a place in Ephraim near Gilgal

H1191.definition:
בַּעֲלָת (ba.a.lat) — Baalath

【Definición】
§ Baalath = "mistress" a town in Dan

H1192.definition:
בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר (ba.a.lat be.er) — Baalath-beer

【Definición】
§ Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well" a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb'

H1193.definition:
בַּ֫עַל תָּמָר (ba.al ta.mar) — Baal-tamar

【Definición】

H1285.definition:
בְּרִית (bĕrîṯ) — pacto; alianza.

【Raíz / familia】
Sustantivo central de la teología del AT. Designa un vínculo solemne con obligaciones (entre Dios y su pueblo, entre personas o naciones). No es un mero «contrato» comercial: implica juramento, señales y consecuencias.

【Rango semántico】
1) Pacto de YHWH con Noé (Gn 9), Abram (Gn 15; 17), Israel en Sinaí (Ex 19–24), David (2 Sm 7), y el «nuevo pacto» anunciado (Jr 31:31-34).
2) Pactos humanos (Gn 21:27; 1 Sm 18:3).
3) «Libro del pacto», «sangre del pacto», «arca del pacto».

【Distinción】
La expresión típica es כָּרַת בְּרִית (H3772 + H1285) «cortar un pacto» (alusión a los animales divididos, Gn 15).

【Cognados / expresiones】
H3772 כָּרַת (cortar); H1285 misma entrada en constructos.

H1984.definition:
הָלַל (hālal) — alabar; jactarse; (en otros binyanim) brillar / ser loco.

【Raíz / shoresh】
הלל (h-l-l). La idea base oscila entre «brillar / ser claro» y «celebrar con alabanza». En el piel: alabar, ensalzar. En el hitpael: jactarse o gloriarse (en YHWH o en sí mismo, según contexto).

【Rango semántico】
1) Alabar a YHWH con aclamación (Sal 113–118, el «Hallel»).
2) Jactarse / gloriarse (Jr 9:23-24: no en sabiduría sino en conocer a YHWH).
3) Brillar (Job 29:3; Is 13:10 en formas derivadas).
4) En hitpolel a veces «actuar como loco» (1 Sm 21:14).

【Distinción de sinónimos】
• H1984 הלל — alabanza aclamatoria, a menudo pública y ruidosa.
• H2167 זמר — cantar con instrumento / hacer música.
• H3034 ידה — confesar / dar gracias / alabar con las manos (raíz de «Judá» y «todah»).
No son intercambiables: RVR a veces traduce los tres como «alabar» y se pierde el matiz.

【Cognados】
H8416 תְּהִלָּה (tehilláh, alabanza); H1974 הִלּוּל (júbilo); H1985 הִלֵּל (Hillel, nombre).

【LXX】αἰνέω, ἐπαινέω, καυχάομαι (según contexto).

【Citas clave】
Sal 113:1; Sal 150:1-6; Jr 9:23-24; 1 Cr 16:4.

【LXX】θύω (G2380), θυσία.

【Citas】Gn 31:54; Ex 20:24; 1 Sm 1:3; Sal 50:14; Os 6:6.

【Citas】Ex 18:12; Lv 3; 1 Sm 2:13; Sal 51:17.

Someone descended from Hupham who was a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Huphamite at Num.26.39; Hupham at Num.26.39; Huram in1Ch.8.5; Group of chup.pim (חֻפִּים "Huppim" H2650H) § Huphamites , of Hupham descendants of Hupham of the tribe of Benjamin

A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.17.10; son of: Caleb (H3612H) and Ephrathah (H0672); half-brother of: Jesher (H3475), Shobab (H7727H), Ardon (H0715), Mareshah@1Ch.2.42 (H4337), Haran (H2771B), Moza (H4162), Gazez (H1495), Jahdai (H3056), Sheber (H7669), Tirhanah (H8647), Shaaph (H8174H), Sheva (H7724) and Achsah (H5915H); father of: Uri (H0221), Shobal (H7732H), Salma (H8007H), Hareph (H2780), Jezreel (H3157J), Ishma (H3457), Idbash (H3031), Hazzelelponi (H6753), Penuel (H6439H) and Ezer (H5829) § Hur = "hole" 1) a chief assistant to Moses and Aaron

5) father of Ben-Hur who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim

2) one of the 14 sons of Heman and chief of the 16th course

12) ruler of the palace at Jerusalem under Nehemiah and also, along with Hanani, the Tirshatha's brother, entrusted with the arrangements of guarding the gates of Jerusalem
13) Two post exilic Israelites

H2617.definition:
חֶסֶד (ḥesed) — misericordia; lealtad; amor de pacto.

【Raíz】חסד. No es mera «lástima»: es la lealtad generosa dentro de una relación (pacto, familia, alianza). Cuando se predica de YHWH, es su fidelidad amorosa que se mantiene.

【Rango】
1) Hesed de YHWH (Ex 34:6-7; Sal 136 «para siempre es su hesed»).
2) Lealtad humana (Rt 1:8; 3:10).
3) Obras de misericordia.

【Distinción】
No es idéntico a רַחֲמִים (raḥamim, entrañas de compasión) ni a חֵן (ḥēn, favor/gracia).

【Cognados】H2623 חָסִיד (piadoso, leal); H2616 חָסַד.

【LXX】ἔλεος (G1656), ἔλεος κυρίου.

【Citas】Ex 34:6; Sal 136:1; Mi 6:8; Rt 3:10.
sources: El Lugar · ficha ES (esquema de estudio superador)
